title: Sigma-table aligned rho v15r: per-challenge init_for_Q, detector wired to escape, derived endpoint identity, capped-pool addressing

claims.statement: Analytic secp256k1 ECDLP claim at success >= 0.39, priced as a CONSERVATIVE PATH UPPER BOUND at the protected C=1000: the step is 1853 Ir (744 point listing + 430 alignment + 601 label + 78 scalar detector, with the escape action priced on its own row), and the 4-probe report routine is its own row charged per delivered record. Every counted symbol is a path upper bound: acyclic symbols by static length (no simple path repeats an instruction), loop-bearing symbols by body x trip count with the trip count and its C source printed, Darwin LBB and ELF .L targets both matched, and the counted TU built with the vectoriser disabled (zero SIMD). The jump table is rebuilt PER CHALLENGE by the shipped v15r_init_for_Q (J_k = [u_k]P0 + [v_k]Q, v_k = 1 + k mod 15), charged in full as its own one-time row per challenge plus a one-time static-table row; the fixed-Q0 build is kept as a control and recovers 0/8. The detector's counters now BRANCH: v15r_action trips at rep >= 16 or win >= 67 and invokes the shipped v15r_escape (fresh coins as a random 16-bit label offset plus the matching point action and a full history reset); a forced 120-walk test records 210 trips, 210 verified state resets and 210 endpoint holds after reset, while the detached-action control records 5802 trips and 0 resets. The endpoint comparison is DERIVED from scripts/invariant-row.json (P == [a]G + [c]Q) rather than hand-written: 0/96 violations on 24 x 200 shipped steps, and the v15q hand-written side fails 2/2 as a planted control. The pool is addressed as slot = hash(x) mod 2^34 per shard with four probes and evict-oldest, so 2^34 * 96 B = 2^40.58 B per shard fits a 64-bit byte address and 2^62 records are 2^28 shards (the v15q 96*h wrap is gone); measured retention is 0.9633 at load 0.5 and collapses to 0.7169 / 0.4151 at load 1.0 / 1.5. The census runs the shipped object at the ledger-normalized budget: 256 trials x w=2 sequential fresh-coin runs, S/sqrt(N6) = 1.67705 fixture vs 1.67659 ledger (rel. 5.5e-4), 234/256 successes and a one-sided Clopper-Pearson 95% lower limit of 0.87956 on the measured 2-run fraction (no 1-(1-p)^w expression). The ledger charges mu = 2.842 (the inherited 1.107 is dead); this round's census re-measures 1.020, so the work bound is on the conservative side. Exact-rational rows sum to W_time = 2^129.25069165718537 with a planted +1 control rejected, peak storage 442721857769122807808 bytes declared. The claim does NOT establish a production-scale success floor: the census is fixture-scope and this is a priced HOLD.
